# Working Holiday Tax - expanded content index (EN / DE / JA)

> A complete, current map of every guide on https://workingholidaytax.com.au, with the description for each. Generated from the live guide data, so it cannot list an article that no longer exists.

## About this file

Generated 2026-08-24 by scripts/generate-llms.mjs. Do not hand edit.

This file is an index, not a dump of article bodies. It lists 141 English guides, 141 German translations and 141 Japanese translations, with the canonical URL, category, publication date and description for each. Fetch the canonical URL for the full text. A localised guide is listed only where a translated body exists; partially translated entries are noindexed and are deliberately omitted.

Authoritative current figures, with effective dates and sources, are in https://workingholidaytax.com.au/llms.txt. Prefer that file for any rate or threshold.

## How a return is handled

Prepared by our team, reviewed and signed off by a registered tax agent before it is lodged with the ATO.

## Guarantee

If your refund is less than our fee, we refund the difference, so you are never out of pocket. Where no refund is payable to you at all, the fee is refunded in full.
